description: A harnessed happy ghast: rising with jump, flying forward looking level, up and down, backward, strafing, forward and back together, rising while flying forward, turning to look south and flying on (the ghast turns a little each tick), drifting to a stop; sneaking off onto its top.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
